description: Migration adds nullable client_billing_profiles.preferred_payment_method with CHECK in ('credit_card','bank_transfer','check'); down migration drops it
Migration adds nullable invoices.payment_method snapshot column; existing rows remain NULL
Single shared PREFERRED_PAYMENT_METHODS constant + type + i18n label keys; BillingConfigForm consumes it instead of its inline list
EffectiveBillingIdentity gains preferredPaymentMethod resolved profile ?? client via inherit(), recording overriddenFields
Resolver normalizes legacy client values: '' or unknown strings resolve to null without throwing
ClientBillingProfileSettingsInput/SETTINGS_FIELDS include preferred_payment_method; get returns stored + effective value
updateClientBillingProfileSettings validates preferred_payment_method against the method list and returns an i18n action error for invalid values; null clears to inherit
Read action returns the profile's default non-deleted saved card (type, last4, expiry) via billingProfilePayments.listPaymentMethods, scoped to profile and client, client:read permission
PaymentMethod interface in packages/types gains billing_profile_id
Profile settings panel renders a Payment method CustomSelect with 'Inherit from client (<value>)' first option; selection saves key or null
Profile settings panel shows read-only card-on-file line ('Visa •••• 4242, exp 04/28' or 'No card on file') with note that cards are managed in the client portal
All new UI/error strings added to msp/clients (and billing) locale files with defaultValue
Recurring invoice generation writes invoices.payment_method from the resolved billing identity of the invoice's profile
Any other invoice creation path that sets invoices.billing_profile_id (manual/API invoices) also snapshots payment_method
WasmInvoiceViewModel gains paymentMethod; invoiceAdapters maps invoices.payment_method key to localized label (null -> null)
Invoice designer fieldCatalog registers invoice.paymentMethod; preview bindings and sample scenarios populate it
